correction_lesson: Player names are NOT in player_season_stats (it keys on player_id). Join players p ON pss.player_id = p.player_id for the name, SUM goals_pss per player, and PL-scope via seasons -> competitions league_code='ENG-PL'.
description: Player-name join pitfall: player_season_stats keys on player_id; the name lives in `players`, goals must be summed per player and PL-scoped via seasons->competitions.

turns.query: Who was Manchester City's top scorer in the 2023-2024 Premier League season, and how many league goals did they score?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON pss.player_id = p.player_id JOIN seasons s ON pss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON pss.team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2023-2024' AND t.team_name = 'Manchester City' GROUP BY p.player_name ORDER BY goals DESC LIMIT 1;

turns.query: Who top-scored for Liverpool in the 2024-2025 Premier League season and with how many goals?
turns.ground_truth_sql: SELECT p.player_name, SUM(pss.goals_pss) AS goals FROM player_season_stats pss JOIN players p ON pss.player_id = p.player_id JOIN seasons s ON pss.season_id = s.season_id JOIN competitions c ON s.competition_id = c.competition_id JOIN teams t ON pss.team_id = t.team_id WHERE c.league_code = 'ENG-PL' AND s.season = '2024-2025' AND t.team_name = 'Liverpool' GROUP BY p.player_name ORDER BY goals DESC LIMIT 1;
